name: opendisplay
description_en: Use an iPhone, iPad, or spare Mac as a true second display for your Mac without restrictions.
readme_excerpt: OpenDisplay Turn your spare Apple devices into second monitors for your Mac — free, open source, no subscription. iPhone, iPad, and spare Macs. A self-hosted alternative to Apple Sidecar, Duet Display, and Luna Display: true extended display (not just mirroring), Retina-sharp, over USB or WiFi, with touch and scroll input.
